purpose: User-requested naked vulnerability negative control; isolated development candidate only; no quick-death numeric threshold approved
scope: Three continuous natural-death attempts plus one independent later-room finite-group control, all CH03 D0 seed1001. No whole-chapter clear.
pair_integrity: Lv21 baseline and candidate identical source hashes, route, loadout and talents. Only existing isolated mage/enemy calibration flags differ.

fixture.choice_authority: Lawful frozen test choice derived from Lv25 fixture, not user-selected optimization

A.description: Q 不再爆炸，改为直线最多穿透 2 敌、各 1.0H 并施加感电；经过节点 90 内仍产生受限回声，失去圆形爆点
A.description_en: Q no longer explodes. It travels in a line through at most 2 enemies, dealing 1.0H and applying Shock to each. Passing within 90 units of nodes still triggers bounded echoes. Loses the circular blast.
A.name: 穿相

B.description: Q 射程缩为 350，爆炸半径增为 100、伤害为 1.35H，冷却增至 6 秒；近距布置换区域收益
B.description_en: Q range decreases to 350, blast radius increases to 100 and damage becomes 1.35H, but cooldown increases to 6 s. Trades safe range for area coverage.
B.name: 压相

A.description: R 持续 7 秒，跳伤次数上限改为7次，每秒伤害0.65H，建场仍0.6H，理论总量5.15H；长驻阵地总量更高，但需要敌人持续留场
A.description_en: R lasts 7 s with up to 7 ticks of 0.65H each; its initial hit stays 0.6H. Maximum single-target total: 5.15H, requiring the target to remain in the field.
A.name: 定星领域

B.description: R 跟随玩家，半径降至140，持续4秒、最多4次跳伤，每秒0.65H，建场仍0.6H，理论总量3.2H；获得移动覆盖，显著牺牲范围与总量
B.description_en: R follows the player, with radius 140, duration 4 s and at most 4 ticks of 0.65H each; its initial hit stays 0.6H. Maximum single-target total: 3.2H. Trades radius and total damage for moving coverage.
B.name: 随行领域

hero_base.description: W布置法晶节点，普攻与技能交替积满共鸣；Q晶爆为节点蓄能，R领域充满场内节点并持续寒冷控制，再用E冰霜新星引爆阵地。
hero_base.description_en: Deploy crystal nodes with W and alternate basics and skills to fill Resonance. Q charges nodes, R fills nodes in its field and applies Chill through its ticks, then E releases a frost nova and detonates the formation.
hero_base.name: 谷频
hero_base.original_visual: 谷频是用哼唱校准旧机器的信号技师，好奇、温和，擅长从噪声中判断矿层变化。单侧圆形接收器、高低错开的电容、短柄叉形针射器形成偏置轮廓；背负器通过线缆连接部署节点，避免常见长袍法师形象。旧白 #D2D1BB、孔雀青 #3E8D8D、深褐 #4B443D。

passive.description: 有效原始普攻与成功技能施放交替时积累共鸣，首次行动记1层，同类连续行动不加层，最多3层；8秒未继续交替则散去。满3层后，下次成功释放Q/W/E/R自动回复8法力，并为自身260范围内最近的一个已展开、未满能且视线可达的己方节点充1层。触发冷却2秒，冷却期间不积攒。空放技能只要合法提交可参与，失败施放不计层不回蓝；多发技能、节点、持续场和附伤不重复触发。无需C/V操作。
passive.description_en: Alternate confirmed original basic attacks and successfully committed skills to build up to 3 Resonance stacks. The first action grants one; repeating the same action type grants none. Progress expires after 8 seconds. At three stacks, the next committed Q/W/E/R restores 8 Mana and charges one nearby armed, unfilled, visible allied node within 260 units. Internal cooldown: 2 seconds, with no accumulation during cooldown. Failed casts and derived hits do not count. No C/V input.
passive.description_v2: 交替施法积攒共鸣：开始时计1层，之后与上次计层技能不同才继续积层（Q→W→Q也有效，不要求3种技能）。第3次回复10法力、附近法晶充1层并使Q剩余冷却减少0.6秒，触发冷却1.2秒。重复同一技能不积层，8秒未继续则清空。普攻不是前置条件；回蓝只是额外奖励，单独Q也可持续使用。失败输入、法晶炮击、领域跳伤及多发弹体都不会重复触发。
passive.description_v2_en: Alternate spells to build Resonance: start at one stack; later casts must differ from the last spell that added a stack (Q→W→Q works; three unique spells are not required). The third restores 10 Mana, charges one nearby crystal and reduces Q remaining cooldown by 0.6 s; internal cooldown 1.2 s. Repeating one spell adds nothing; stacks expire after 8 s. Basics are not required. This is an optional bonus; Q is sustainable alone. Failed inputs, crystal shots, field ticks and missiles never trigger extra refunds.
passive.name: 交响回路

hero_base.quick_start_v2: Q持续输出；被近身按E；把W和R放进怪群。法晶充能与连携回蓝会自动发生，不必先学复杂连招。
hero_base.quick_start_v2_en: Use Q for steady damage, E when enemies close in, and place W/R on packs. Crystal charging and weaving refunds are automatic extras; no complex combo is required.
hero_base.role: 奥术法师 · 法晶布阵 · 冰霜领域
hero_base.role_en: Arcane mage · Crystal formation · Frost control

f.description:
动作：聚霜0.14秒 → 新星窗0.08秒 → 收势0.18秒。自身半径140造成0.8H魔法伤害并施加寒冷；同时消费自身260内、已展开且视线可达的法晶节点。
每节点爆炸一次，造成(1.0+0.65×层数)H派生魔法伤害，半径100+20×层数；3层为2.95H、半径160。两节点可重叠，零层也能引爆；引爆不施加状态、不消费感电、不触发装备链。
代价：25法力，冷却11秒。无节点时仍释放自身寒冷环并正常扣费；展开中的节点不能引爆。W布阵、Q充能或R充满后，E以冰晶尖环与青色新星释放阵地。3级解锁后，连接范围内节点按冷却、法力和动作状态显示技能可用徽标。
f.description_en: Gather frost for 0.14 s, release over 0.08 s, then recover for 0.18 s. Deal 0.8H magic damage and Chill within 140 of yourself. Consume every armed crystal node within 260 and line of sight; each explodes once for (1.0 + 0.65 per charge)H derived magic damage in radius 100 + 20 per charge. Three charges give 2.95H and radius 160. Two blasts may overlap; zero-charge nodes can detonate. Node blasts cannot apply or consume status or trigger equipment. Costs 25 Mana; cooldown 11 s. With no nodes, the personal frost ring still casts normally. Unfolding nodes cannot detonate. Ice spikes and a cyan nova identify the cast; after level 3, connected node badges reflect cooldown, Mana and action readiness.
f.name: 冰霜新星
f.summary_v2: 被近身时按下：伤害并减速周围敌人。
f.summary_v2_en: When enemies close in, damage and slow everything nearby.

q.description:
动作：聚晶0.18秒 → 出手窗0.06秒 → 收势0.12秒。发射速度650、射程550的奥术晶弹，首次命中或到达终点时半径65爆开，造成1.25H魔法伤害并施加感电；同敌一次，地形挡弹与爆炸视线。
代价：18法力，冷却5秒。爆心90内节点各发出半径70、0.35H派生魔法回声，同敌同次施放最多一次回声；回声不施加感电，不触发被动或自身递归。
布阵与反馈：弹体经过已展开节点90内为其充1层，最多3层；同次施放每节点最多一次。先W布晶、Q蓄能，再用E新星消费阵地。紫青菱晶、符文尾迹与清亮晶击区分奥术弹，爆点停在墙前。
q.description_en: Gather a crystal for 0.18 s, release over 0.06 s, then recover for 0.12 s. Fire at 650 speed and 550 range; the first impact or endpoint bursts in a 65 radius for 1.25H magic damage and Shock, once per target. Terrain blocks projectile and blast. Costs 18 Mana; cooldown 5 s. Nodes within 90 of the burst emit 0.35H derived magic echoes in a 70 radius, at most one echo per target per cast. Echoes cannot apply Shock or trigger other effects. Passing within 90 of an active node adds one charge, up to three, once per node per cast. Violet-cyan crystals, runic trails and a clear crystal impact identify the arcane shot.
q.name: 奥术晶爆
q.summary_v2: 朝准星发射晶弹，命中爆炸；可反复施放。
q.summary_v2_en: Fire an exploding crystal toward the cursor; cast it frequently.

secondary.description:
动作：布晶预备0.20秒 → 出手窗0.08秒 → 收势0.16秒。在最远220的合法地面部署法晶节点，0.35秒展开，存活14秒、35生命，最多2个；每1.2秒攻击160内一敌，造成0.15H派生魔法伤害。
代价：30法力，冷却3.5秒。超上限替换最早节点，不返蓝、不免费引爆。
布阵与反馈：每节点最多3层电荷，Q经过90内充1层，R充满场内已展开节点；交响回路也可给附近未满能节点补1层。E引爆260内已展开、视线可达的节点，伤害(1.0+0.65×层数)H、半径100+20×层数，零层也可引爆。法晶的三枚晶格显示层数；节点攻击和引爆不参与原始普攻、感电消费或装备命中链。
secondary.description_en: Prepare for 0.20 s, release over 0.08 s, then recover for 0.16 s. Deploy a crystal node on legal ground within 220 units. It arms after 0.35 s, lasts 14 s, has 35 health and attacks one enemy within 160 every 1.2 s for 0.15H derived magic damage. Costs 30 Mana; cooldown 3.5 s. Maximum two nodes; replacing the oldest gives no refund or explosion. Each holds three charges: Q adds one when passing within 90, R fills active nodes in its field, and Alternating Resonance can charge a nearby unfilled node. E consumes armed, visible nodes within 260 for (1.0 + 0.65 per charge)H in radius 100 + 20 per charge, even at zero charge. Three crystal sockets show energy; derived node damage cannot trigger hit chains or consume Shock.
secondary.name: 星界法晶
secondary.summary_v2: 落点立即晶爆，再留下自动攻击的法晶。
secondary.summary_v2_en: Blast the target area, leaving a crystal that attacks automatically.

ultimate.description:
动作：聚星0.40秒 → 建场窗0.10秒 → 收势0.30秒。最远280的合法地面建立半径180、持续5秒的领域；建场直击0.6H魔法伤害并施加感电，随后每完整1秒造成0.8H派生魔法伤害并施加寒冷，最多5跳。全程命中理论总量4.6H。
代价：60法力，冷却48秒。持续跳伤只在实际造成生命或护盾伤害时施加寒冷，不消费感电、不触发原始普攻或装备命中链；建场直击仍为原始技能命中。每跳最多12敌，按距中心、再实体ID稳定选取，地形阻挡伤害视线。
布阵与反馈：建场时充满场内且视线可达的已展开节点，不自动引爆；再接E消费。施放结束后可继续移动和普攻，离场敌人不受后续跳伤。紫青法阵、星形脉冲和空灵短乐句标明领域；寒冷沿用共享规则，普通敌人减速20%、Boss减速10%，基础持续3秒并遵守已有时长修正。
ultimate.description_en: Gather stars for 0.40 s, establish the field over 0.10 s, then recover for 0.30 s. Create a 180-radius field on legal ground within 280 for 5 s. The initial original skill hit deals 0.6H magic damage and applies Shock; each full second then deals 0.8H derived magic damage and applies Chill, up to five ticks. Maximum single-target coefficient: 4.6H. Costs 60 Mana; cooldown 48 s. Ticks apply Chill only on actual health or shield damage and cannot consume Shock or trigger original-hit or equipment chains. Each tick resolves at most 12 enemies, ordered by distance then entity ID, with terrain line of sight. On creation, fill active visible nodes inside the field without consuming them. Violet-cyan runes and star pulses mark the field. Chill uses the shared 20% ordinary-enemy or 10% boss slow and base 3 s duration with existing duration modifiers.
ultimate.name: 星陨领域
ultimate.summary_v2: 把星陨领域放进怪群，持续伤害并减速。
ultimate.summary_v2_en: Place a starfall field on a pack for repeated damage and slows.

hero_base.title: 拾频者

upgrades.description_en: Q projectile speed increases from 650 to 850; range is unchanged.
Secondary node health increases from 35 to 50; node limit is unchanged.
E cooldown decreases from 11 s to 9 s.
R radius increases from 180 to 210.

f.description:
动作：聚霜0.14秒 → 新星窗0.08秒 → 收势0.18秒。自身半径140造成0.8H魔法伤害并施加寒冷；同时消费自身260内、已展开且视线可达的法晶节点。
每节点爆炸一次，造成(1.0+0.65×层数)H派生魔法伤害，半径100+20×层数；3层为2.95H、半径160。两节点可重叠，零层也能引爆；引爆不施加状态、不消费感电、不触发装备链。
代价：25法力，冷却11秒。无节点时仍释放自身寒冷环并正常扣费；展开中的节点不能引爆。W布阵、Q充能或R充满后，E以冰晶尖环与青色新星释放阵地。3级解锁后，连接范围内节点按冷却、法力和动作状态显示技能可用徽标。
f.description_en: Gather frost for 0.14 s, release over 0.08 s, then recover for 0.18 s. Deal 0.8H magic damage and Chill within 140 of yourself. Consume every armed crystal node within 260 and line of sight; each explodes once for (1.0 + 0.65 per charge)H derived magic damage in radius 100 + 20 per charge. Three charges give 2.95H and radius 160. Two blasts may overlap; zero-charge nodes can detonate. Node blasts cannot apply or consume status or trigger equipment. Costs 25 Mana; cooldown 11 s. With no nodes, the personal frost ring still casts normally. Unfolding nodes cannot detonate. Ice spikes and a cyan nova identify the cast; after level 3, connected node badges reflect cooldown, Mana and action readiness.
f.name: 冰霜新星
f.summary_v2: 被近身时按下：伤害并减速周围敌人。
f.summary_v2_en: When enemies close in, damage and slow everything nearby.

q.description:

代价：18法力，冷却5秒。爆心90内节点各发出半径70、0.35H派生魔法回声，同敌同次施放最多一次回声；回声不施加感电，不触发被动或自身递归。

q.description_en: Gather a crystal for 0.18 s, release over 0.06 s, then recover for 0.12 s. Fire at 650 speed and 550 range; the first impact or endpoint bursts in a 65 radius for 1.25H magic damage and Shock, once per target. Terrain blocks projectile and blast. Costs 18 Mana; cooldown 5 s. Nodes within 90 of the burst emit 0.35H derived magic echoes in a 70 radius, at most one echo per target per cast. Echoes cannot apply Shock or trigger other effects. Passing within 90 of an active node adds one charge, up to three, once per node per cast. Violet-cyan crystals, runic trails and a clear crystal impact identify the arcane shot.
q.name: 奥术晶爆
q.summary_v2: 朝准星发射晶弹，命中爆炸；可反复施放。
q.summary_v2_en: Fire an exploding crystal toward the cursor; cast it frequently.

secondary.description:

代价：30法力，冷却3.5秒。超上限替换最早节点，不返蓝、不免费引爆。

secondary.description_en: Prepare for 0.20 s, release over 0.08 s, then recover for 0.16 s. Deploy a crystal node on legal ground within 220 units. Maximum two nodes; replacing the oldest gives no refund or explosion. Each holds three charges: Q adds one when passing within 90, R fills active nodes in its field, and Alternating Resonance can charge a nearby unfilled node. E consumes armed, visible nodes within 260 for (1.0 + 0.65 per charge)H in radius 100 + 20 per charge, even at zero charge. Three crystal sockets show energy; derived node damage cannot trigger hit chains or consume Shock.
secondary.name: 星界法晶
secondary.summary_v2: 落点立即晶爆，再留下自动攻击的法晶。
secondary.summary_v2_en: Blast the target area, leaving a crystal that attacks automatically.

ultimate.description:

布阵与反馈：建场时充满场内且视线可达的已展开节点，不自动引爆；再接E消费。施放结束后可继续移动和普攻，离场敌人不受后续跳伤。紫青法阵、星形脉冲和空灵短乐句标明领域；寒冷沿用共享规则，普通敌人减速20%、Boss减速10%，基础持续3秒并遵守已有时长修正。
ultimate.description_en: Gather stars for 0.40 s, establish the field over 0.10 s, then recover for 0.30 s. Create a 180-radius field on legal ground within 280 for 5 s. 每节点爆炸一次，造成(1.0+0.65×层数)H派生魔法伤害，半径100+20×层数；3层为2.95H、半径160。两节点可重叠，零层也能引爆；引爆不施加状态、不消费感电、不触发装备链。

f.description_en: Gather frost for 0.14 s, release over 0.08 s, then recover for 0.18 s. Deal 0.8H magic damage and Chill within 140 of yourself. Consume every armed crystal node within 260 and line of sight; each explodes once for (1.0 + 0.65 per charge)H derived magic damage in radius 100 + 20 per charge. With no nodes, the personal frost ring still casts normally. Unfolding nodes cannot detonate. Ice spikes and a cyan nova identify the cast; after level 3, connected node badges reflect cooldown, Mana and action readiness.
f.name: 冰霜新星
f.summary_v2: 被近身时按下：伤害并减速周围敌人。
f.summary_v2_en: When enemies close in, damage and slow everything nearby.

q.description:
动作：聚晶0.18秒 → 出手窗0.06秒 → 收势0.12秒。发射速度650、射程550的奥术晶弹，首次命中或到达终点时半径65爆开，造成1.25H魔法伤害并施加感电；同敌一次，地形挡弹与爆炸视线。
代价：18法力，冷却5秒。爆心90内节点各发出半径70、0.35H派生魔法回声，同敌同次施放最多一次回声；回声不施加感电，不触发被动或自身递归。
布阵与反馈：弹体经过已展开节点90内为其充1层，最多3层；同次施放每节点最多一次。先W布晶、Q蓄能，再用E新星消费阵地。紫青菱晶、符文尾迹与清亮晶击区分奥术弹，爆点停在墙前。
q.description_en: Gather a crystal for 0.18 s, release over 0.06 s, then recover for 0.12 s. Fire at 650 speed and 550 range; the first impact or endpoint bursts in a 65 radius for 1.25H magic damage and Shock, once per target. Terrain blocks projectile and blast. Costs 18 Mana; cooldown 5 s. Nodes within 90 of the burst emit 0.35H derived magic echoes in a 70 radius, at most one echo per target per cast. Echoes cannot apply Shock or trigger other effects. Passing within 90 of an active node adds one charge, up to three, once per node per cast. Violet-cyan crystals, runic trails and a clear crystal impact identify the arcane shot.
q.name: 奥术晶爆
q.summary_v2: 朝准星发射晶弹，命中爆炸；可反复施放。
q.summary_v2_en: Fire an exploding crystal toward the cursor; cast it frequently.

Three crystal sockets show energy; derived node damage cannot trigger hit chains or consume Shock.

secondary.summary_v2: 落点立即晶爆，再留下自动攻击的法晶。
secondary.summary_v2_en: Blast the target area, leaving a crystal that attacks automatically.

ultimate.summary_v2_en: Place a starfall field on a pack for repeated damage and slows.

passive.description: 有效原始普攻与成功技能施放交替时积累共鸣，首次行动记1层，同类连续行动不加层，最多3层；8秒未继续交替则散去。满3层后，下次成功释放Q/W/E/R自动回复8法力，并为自身260范围内最近的一个已展开、未满能且视线可达的己方节点充1层。触发冷却2秒，冷却期间不积攒。空放技能只要合法提交可参与，失败施放不计层不回蓝；多发技能、节点、持续场和附伤不重复触发。无需C/V操作。
passive.description_en: Alternate confirmed original basic attacks and successfully committed skills to build up to 3 Resonance stacks. The first action grants one; repeating the same action type grants none. Progress expires after 8 seconds. At three stacks, the next committed Q/W/E/R restores 8 Mana and charges one nearby armed, unfilled, visible allied node within 260 units. Internal cooldown: 2 seconds, with no accumulation during cooldown. Failed casts and derived hits do not count. No C/V input.
passive.description_v2: 交替施法积攒共鸣：开始时计1层，之后与上次计层技能不同才继续积层（Q→W→Q也有效，不要求3种技能）。第3次回复10法力、附近法晶充1层并使Q剩余冷却减少0.6秒，触发冷却1.2秒。重复同一技能不积层，8秒未继续则清空。普攻不是前置条件；回蓝只是额外奖励，单独Q也可持续使用。失败输入、法晶炮击、领域跳伤及多发弹体都不会重复触发。
passive.description_v2_en: Alternate spells to build Resonance: start at one stack; later casts must differ from the last spell that added a stack (Q→W→Q works; three unique spells are not required). The third restores 10 Mana, charges one nearby crystal and reduces Q remaining cooldown by 0.6 s; internal cooldown 1.2 s. Repeating one spell adds nothing; stacks expire after 8 s. Basics are not required. This is an optional bonus; Q is sustainable alone. Failed inputs, crystal shots, field ticks and missiles never trigger extra refunds.
passive.name: 交响回路

hero_base.quick_start_v2: Q持续输出；被近身按E；把W和R放进怪群。法晶充能与连携回蓝会自动发生，不必先学复杂连招。
hero_base.quick_start_v2_en: Use Q for steady damage, E when enemies close in, and place W/R on packs. Crystal charging and weaving refunds are automatic extras; no complex combo is required.
hero_base.role: 奥术法师 · 法晶布阵 · 冰霜领域
hero_base.role_en: Arcane mage · Crystal formation · Frost control

f.description:
动作：聚霜0.14秒 → 新星窗0.08秒 → 收势0.18秒。自身半径140造成0.8H魔法伤害并施加寒冷；同时消费自身260内、已展开且视线可达的法晶节点。
每节点爆炸一次，造成(1.0+0.65×层数)H派生魔法伤害，半径100+20×层数；3层为2.95H、半径160。两节点可重叠，零层也能引爆；引爆不施加状态、不消费感电、不触发装备链。
代价：25法力，冷却11秒。无节点时仍释放自身寒冷环并正常扣费；展开中的节点不能引爆。W布阵、Q充能或R充满后，E以冰晶尖环与青色新星释放阵地。3级解锁后，连接范围内节点按冷却、法力和动作状态显示技能可用徽标。
f.description_en: Gather frost for 0.14 s, release over 0.08 s, then recover for 0.18 s. Deal 0.8H magic damage and Chill within 140 of yourself. Consume every armed crystal node within 260 and line of sight; each explodes once for (1.0 + 0.65 per charge)H derived magic damage in radius 100 + 20 per charge. Three charges give 2.95H and radius 160. Two blasts may overlap; zero-charge nodes can detonate. Node blasts cannot apply or consume status or trigger equipment. Costs 25 Mana; cooldown 11 s. With no nodes, the personal frost ring still casts normally. Unfolding nodes cannot detonate. Ice spikes and a cyan nova identify the cast; after level 3, connected node badges reflect cooldown, Mana and action readiness.
f.name: 冰霜新星
f.summary_v2: 被近身时按下：伤害并减速周围敌人。
f.summary_v2_en: When enemies close in, damage and slow everything nearby.

q.description:
动作：聚晶0.18秒 → 出手窗0.06秒 → 收势0.12秒。发射速度650、射程550的奥术晶弹，首次命中或到达终点时半径65爆开，造成1.25H魔法伤害并施加感电；同敌一次，地形挡弹与爆炸视线。
代价：18法力，冷却5秒。爆心90内节点各发出半径70、0.35H派生魔法回声，同敌同次施放最多一次回声；回声不施加感电，不触发被动或自身递归。
布阵与反馈：弹体经过已展开节点90内为其充1层，最多3层；同次施放每节点最多一次。先W布晶、Q蓄能，再用E新星消费阵地。紫青菱晶、符文尾迹与清亮晶击区分奥术弹，爆点停在墙前。
q.description_en: Gather a crystal for 0.18 s, release over 0.06 s, then recover for 0.12 s. Fire at 650 speed and 550 range; the first impact or endpoint bursts in a 65 radius for 1.25H magic damage and Shock, once per target. Terrain blocks projectile and blast. Costs 18 Mana; cooldown 5 s. Nodes within 90 of the burst emit 0.35H derived magic echoes in a 70 radius, at most one echo per target per cast. Echoes cannot apply Shock or trigger other effects. Passing within 90 of an active node adds one charge, up to three, once per node per cast. Violet-cyan crystals, runic trails and a clear crystal impact identify the arcane shot.
q.name: 奥术晶爆
q.summary_v2: 朝准星发射晶弹，命中爆炸；可反复施放。
q.summary_v2_en: Fire an exploding crystal toward the cursor; cast it frequently.

secondary.summary_v2_en: Blast the target area, leaving a crystal that attacks automatically.

hero_base.original_visual: 谷频是用哼唱校准旧机器的信号技师，好奇、温和，擅长从噪声中判断矿层变化。单侧圆形接收器、高低错开的电容、短柄叉形针射器形成偏置轮廓；背负器通过线缆连接部署节点，避免常见长袍法师形象。旧白 #D2D1BB、孔雀青 #3E8D8D、深褐 #4B443D。

passive.description: 有效原始普攻与成功技能施放交替时积累共鸣，首次行动记1层，同类连续行动不加层，最多3层；8秒未继续交替则散去。满3层后，下次成功释放Q/W/E/R自动回复8法力，并为自身260范围内最近的一个已展开、未满能且视线可达的己方节点充1层。触发冷却2秒，冷却期间不积攒。空放技能只要合法提交可参与，失败施放不计层不回蓝；多发技能、节点、持续场和附伤不重复触发。无需C/V操作。
passive.description_en: Alternate confirmed original basic attacks and successfully committed skills to build up to 3 Resonance stacks. The first action grants one; repeating the same action type grants none. Progress expires after 8 seconds. At three stacks, the next committed Q/W/E/R restores 8 Mana and charges one nearby armed, unfilled, visible allied node within 260 units. Internal cooldown: 2 seconds, with no accumulation during cooldown. Failed casts and derived hits do not count. No C/V input.
passive.description_v2: 交替施法积攒共鸣：开始时计1层，之后与上次计层技能不同才继续积层（Q→W→Q也有效，不要求3种技能）。第3次回复10法力、附近法晶充1层并使Q剩余冷却减少0.6秒，触发冷却1.2秒。重复同一技能不积层，8秒未继续则清空。普攻不是前置条件；回蓝只是额外奖励，单独Q也可持续使用。失败输入、法晶炮击、领域跳伤及多发弹体都不会重复触发。
passive.description_v2_en: Alternate spells to build Resonance: start at one stack; later casts must differ from the last spell that added a stack (Q→W→Q works; three unique spells are not required). The third restores 10 Mana, charges one nearby crystal and reduces Q remaining cooldown by 0.6 s; internal cooldown 1.2 s. Repeating one spell adds nothing; stacks expire after 8 s. Basics are not required. This is an optional bonus; Q is sustainable alone. Failed inputs, crystal shots, field ticks and missiles never trigger extra refunds.
passive.name: 交响回路

hero_base.quick_start_v2: Q持续输出；被近身按E；把W和R放进怪群。法晶充能与连携回蓝会自动发生，不必先学复杂连招。
hero_base.quick_start_v2_en: Use Q for steady damage, E when enemies close in, and place W/R on packs. Crystal charging and weaving refunds are automatic extras; no complex combo is required.
hero_base.role: 奥术法师 · 法晶布阵 · 冰霜领域
hero_base.role_en: Arcane mage · Crystal formation · Frost control

f.description:
动作：聚霜0.14秒 → 新星窗0.08秒 → 收势0.18秒。自身半径140造成0.8H魔法伤害并施加寒冷；同时消费自身260内、已展开且视线可达的法晶节点。
每节点爆炸一次，造成(1.0+0.65×层数)H派生魔法伤害，半径100+20×层数；3层为2.95H、半径160。两节点可重叠，零层也能引爆；引爆不施加状态、不消费感电、不触发装备链。
代价：25法力，冷却11秒。无节点时仍释放自身寒冷环并正常扣费；展开中的节点不能引爆。W布阵、Q充能或R充满后，E以冰晶尖环与青色新星释放阵地。3级解锁后，连接范围内节点按冷却、法力和动作状态显示技能可用徽标。
f.description_en: Gather frost for 0.14 s, release over 0.08 s, then recover for 0.18 s. Deal 0.8H magic damage and Chill within 140 of yourself. Consume every armed crystal node within 260 and line of sight; each explodes once for (1.0 + 0.65 per charge)H derived magic damage in radius 100 + 20 per charge. Three charges give 2.95H and radius 160. Two blasts may overlap; zero-charge nodes can detonate. Node blasts cannot apply or consume status or trigger equipment. Costs 25 Mana; cooldown 11 s. With no nodes, the personal frost ring still casts normally. Unfolding nodes cannot detonate. Ice spikes and a cyan nova identify the cast; after level 3, connected node badges reflect cooldown, Mana and action readiness.
f.name: 冰霜新星
f.summary_v2: 被近身时按下：伤害并减速周围敌人。
f.summary_v2_en: When enemies close in, damage and slow everything nearby.

q.description:
动作：聚晶0.18秒 → 出手窗0.06秒 → 收势0.12秒。发射速度650、射程550的奥术晶弹，首次命中或到达终点时半径65爆开，造成1.25H魔法伤害并施加感电；同敌一次，地形挡弹与爆炸视线。
代价：18法力，冷却5秒。爆心90内节点各发出半径70、0.35H派生魔法回声，同敌同次施放最多一次回声；回声不施加感电，不触发被动或自身递归。
布阵与反馈：弹体经过已展开节点90内为其充1层，最多3层；同次施放每节点最多一次。先W布晶、Q蓄能，再用E新星消费阵地。紫青菱晶、符文尾迹与清亮晶击区分奥术弹，爆点停在墙前。
q.description_en: Gather a crystal for 0.18 s, release over 0.06 s, then recover for 0.12 s. Fire at 650 speed and 550 range; the first impact or endpoint bursts in a 65 radius for 1.25H magic damage and Shock, once per target. Terrain blocks projectile and blast. Costs 18 Mana; cooldown 5 s. Nodes within 90 of the burst emit 0.35H derived magic echoes in a 70 radius, at most one echo per target per cast. Echoes cannot apply Shock or trigger other effects. Passing within 90 of an active node adds one charge, up to three, once per node per cast. Violet-cyan crystals, runic trails and a clear crystal impact identify the arcane shot.
q.name: 奥术晶爆
q.summary_v2: 朝准星发射晶弹，命中爆炸；可反复施放。
q.summary_v2_en: Fire an exploding crystal toward the cursor; cast it frequently.

secondary.description:
动作：布晶预备0.20秒 → 出手窗0.08秒 → 收势0.16秒。在最远220的合法地面部署法晶节点，0.35秒展开，存活14秒、35生命，最多2个；每1.2秒攻击160内一敌，造成0.15H派生魔法伤害。
代价：30法力，冷却3.5秒。超上限替换最早节点，不返蓝、不免费引爆。
布阵与反馈：每节点最多3层电荷，Q经过90内充1层，R充满场内已展开节点；交响回路也可给附近未满能节点补1层。E引爆260内已展开、视线可达的节点，伤害(1.0+0.65×层数)H、半径100+20×层数，零层也可引爆。法晶的三枚晶格显示层数；节点攻击和引爆不参与原始普攻、感电消费或装备命中链。
secondary.description_en: Prepare for 0.20 s, release over 0.08 s, then recover for 0.16 s. Deploy a crystal node on legal ground within 220 units. It arms after 0.35 s, lasts 14 s, has 35 health and attacks one enemy within 160 every 1.2 s for 0.15H derived magic damage. Costs 30 Mana; cooldown 3.5 s. Maximum two nodes; replacing the oldest gives no refund or explosion. Each holds three charges: Q adds one when passing within 90, R fills active nodes in its field, and Alternating Resonance can charge a nearby unfilled node. E consumes armed, visible nodes within 260 for (1.0 + 0.65 per charge)H in radius 100 + 20 per charge, even at zero charge. Three crystal sockets show energy; derived node damage cannot trigger hit chains or consume Shock.
secondary.name: 星界法晶
secondary.summary_v2: 落点立即晶爆，再留下自动攻击的法晶。
secondary.summary_v2_en: Blast the target area, leaving a crystal that attacks automatically.

ultimate.description:
动作：聚星0.40秒 → 建场窗0.10秒 → 收势0.30秒。最远280的合法地面建立半径180、持续5秒的领域；建场直击0.6H魔法伤害并施加感电，随后每完整1秒造成0.8H派生魔法伤害并施加寒冷，最多5跳。全程命中理论总量4.6H。
代价：60法力，冷却48秒。持续跳伤只在实际造成生命或护盾伤害时施加寒冷，不消费感电、不触发原始普攻或装备命中链；建场直击仍为原始技能命中。每跳最多12敌，按距中心、再实体ID稳定选取，地形阻挡伤害视线。
布阵与反馈：建场时充满场内且视线可达的已展开节点，不自动引爆；再接E消费。施放结束后可继续移动和普攻，离场敌人不受后续跳伤。紫青法阵、星形脉冲和空灵短乐句标明领域；寒冷沿用共享规则，普通敌人减速20%、Boss减速10%，基础持续3秒并遵守已有时长修正。
ultimate.description_en: Gather stars for 0.40 s, establish the field over 0.10 s, then recover for 0.30 s. Create a 180-radius field on legal ground within 280 for 5 s. The initial original skill hit deals 0.6H magic damage and applies Shock; each full second then deals 0.8H derived magic damage and applies Chill, up to five ticks. Maximum single-target coefficient: 4.6H. Costs 60 Mana; cooldown 48 s. Ticks apply Chill only on actual health or shield damage and cannot consume Shock or trigger original-hit or equipment chains. Each tick resolves at most 12 enemies, ordered by distance then entity ID, with terrain line of sight. On creation, fill active visible nodes inside the field without consuming them. Violet-cyan runes and star pulses mark the field. Chill uses the shared 20% ordinary-enemy or 10% boss slow and base 3 s duration with existing duration modifiers.
ultimate.name: 星陨领域
ultimate.summary_v2: 把星陨领域放进怪群，持续伤害并减速。
ultimate.summary_v2_en: Place a starfall field on a pack for repeated damage and slows.
